To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the nuclear matrix of regenerating rat liver contains an RNA priming activity which can be used to prime and continue DNA synthesis in an in vitro system.
the nuclear matrix contains an RNA primase which is capable of initiating DNA replication in vitro and that the RNA priming activity is located in the nuclear matrix internal structure.
the nuclear matrix of regenerating rat liver contains a DNA priming activity which synthesizes RNA-DNA hybrids on either endogenous or exogenous templates.   1.
In summary, our research is concerned with
elucidating the molecular mechanisms of eukaryotic DNA replication in vivo by using an in vitro system that is derived from the cell nucleus.
the characterization of a nuclear matrix associated priming and continuation reaction in vitro.

the study of the nuclear matrix as a structural component of the cell nucleus and with the elucidation of its role as a functional component in the regulation of cell proliferation and differentiation.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the nuclear matrix is a highly organized and functional structure which contains a DNA replication system that is capable of priming, elongation and termination of DNA replication.
the nuclear matrix is an essential and integral component of the DNA replication apparatus in eucaryotes.
the nuclear matrix is a site where DNA replication is initiated, and where RNA primers are formed and extended.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the nuclear matrix is an essential structural framework in the cell nucleus for organizing the replication apparatus and that the nuclear matrix-associated priming system may be a major contributor in the initiation of eucaryote DNA synthesis.
the nuclear matrix is a site of RNA priming of nascent DNA in regenerating liver.
the nuclear matrix contains a DNA priming system that may be involved in nuclear DNA replication.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the nuclear matrix is an important component in eucaryotic RNA priming.
the matrix-bound DNA priming system may be involved in DNA repair, recombination, and/or gene expression.

the nuclear matrix is an important component for the regulation of the DNA primase activity and that this activity is not a simple reflection of the activity of the DNA polymerase alpha-primase complex in solution.
